content.title: AITWIRE vs Profound
content.intro:
AITWIRE is a vendor-neutral performance layer that measures how AI systems answer about a business, manages the approved knowledge those systems should follow, tests what changes across model updates, and preserves evidence across models, vendors, and applications. AITWIRE publishes a business's verified facts to the authority surfaces it manages, then re-measures whether AI answers changed — giving teams a documented, threshold-tested record of AI behaviour over time. AITWIRE offers a structured plan ladder — Free, Standard, Pro, and AITWIRE AI — alongside one-time report products (AI Answer Benchmark Report at $49, AI Answer Report at $149, and AI Answer Assurance Report at $499), and a formal engagement tier called AITWIRE Assurance that produces sealed evidence for compliance or audit purposes.

Profound operates in the AI visibility and answer-engine optimisation space. Based on AITWIRE's probing of Profound across multiple AI systems between May and August 2026, Profound is a recognised name in this category — named in answers frequently and discussed in largely neutral-to-positive terms. What Profound's product specifically does, how it is priced, and what plans it offers are not verified in this context and are marked accordingly.
content.competitor_description: Profound is a platform focused on helping brands understand and improve how they appear in AI-generated answers. It targets marketing and brand teams seeking visibility into how AI assistants represent their company. Based on publicly available signals, Profound's approach centres on monitoring AI answer surfaces and providing recommendations to improve brand presence in those answers. Specific feature details, pricing tiers, update cadences, and integration capabilities are not verified in this context — buyers should confirm current capabilities directly with Profound (varies / verify).

differentiators: AITWIRE covers the full performance cycle — measuring AI answers, managing the verified knowledge AI should follow, publishing corrections to authority surfaces, and re-measuring whether answers changed — rather than monitoring alone.
AITWIRE Assurance and the AI Answer Assurance Report ($499) produce threshold-tested, sealed findings suitable for compliance or audit purposes, a deliverable not verified as available from Profound.
AITWIRE's plan ladder includes a formal daily-cadence tier (AITWIRE AI) with a contract-sized on-demand assessment quota (30/month baseline), supporting enterprise-scale continuous measurement.
Three fixed-price one-time report products ($49, $149, $499) let buyers commission a specific measured run without committing to a subscription.
AITWIRE AI runs the AITWIRE Console from within AI assistants the customer already uses (including ChatGPT), reducing workflow friction for teams already operating inside those tools.

pros: Structured plan ladder with published cadences: monthly (Standard), weekly (Pro), daily (AITWIRE AI)
Three fixed-price one-time report products provide entry points without subscription commitment
AITWIRE Assurance tier produces sealed, threshold-tested evidence for compliance and audit use cases
Vendor-neutral scope spans public and private AI, multiple models, vendors, and applications
AITWIRE AI integrates with AI assistants the customer already uses, running the console from within those tools
cons: AITWIRE Free includes no measured AI answer cycle — the AI Readiness Assessment covers the business's own surfaces only, not what AI systems say
The scheduled measured cycle starts at AITWIRE Standard; buyers needing ongoing AI answer measurement must move beyond the free tier

pros: Named in answers in 82% of probes across multiple AI systems (AITWIRE measurement, May–Aug 2026, 11,122 probes), indicating strong AI system recognition
Tone of answers that named Profound was 77% neutral and 20% positive, suggesting broadly favourable framing in AI-generated content (AITWIRE measurement, same period)
Established presence in the AI answer visibility category, reflected in consistent mention rates across probed systems

content.summary: AITWIRE and Profound both operate in the space of understanding how AI systems represent a business, but the verified capabilities differ in documented ways. AITWIRE offers a published plan ladder with defined measurement cadences (monthly, weekly, daily), fixed-price one-time report products at $49, $149, and $499, a formal audit-grade engagement tier (AITWIRE Assurance), and an entry-level AI Readiness Assessment that checks a business's own surfaces without a measured AI answer cycle. Profound is a recognised name in AI answer visibility — named in 82% of answers across 11,122 probes run by AITWIRE between May and August 2026 — but its specific features, pricing, and cadences are not verified here and should be confirmed directly. Buyers whose requirements include sealed audit evidence, a formal cadence ladder, or fixed-scope one-time measurement runs will find those capabilities explicitly documented in AITWIRE's offering; buyers whose primary need is brand visibility monitoring in AI answers should evaluate Profound's current feature set directly.
